fixture_policy: The two unchanged source text files retain their HUPO-PSI/ProForma origin, sync date and commit comments. Native tests execute all 176 positive lines using the source ion-dispatch heuristic and all 22 negative lines using source single-chain parse. All 62 inline source component calls are also preserved. No executed C++ parser differential test or full SDK build is claimed. The separate historical writer manifest/probe is unchanged.
implemented_scope: Complete source single-chain text grammar on Peptidoform::parse.
Complete source ion/chimeric text grammar on PeptidoformIon::parse.
All 15 ErrorCode values and strings, owned ParseError context/getters/setter/formatting, separate checked resource failures.
remaining_scope: Complete tagged JSON schema and codecs.
Modification resolution and AASequence conversion with policies/issues.
native_differences: Owned Rust values and byte-window diagnostics replace source references/exceptions; no ABI or global exception handler emulation.
Input/work/nodes/cumulative capacity/nesting limits return Resource and publish no partial AST.
i32 integer/sign overflow and nonfinite numeric results are checked.
Finite representable f64 subnormals retained; nonzero decimal rounding to zero rejected, unlike platform-dependent std::stod ERANGE behavior.
Locale-independent ASCII token and residue classification plus decimal conversion.
Invalid UTF-8 is rejected only when an individually published source token field cannot be represented as String; intact Unicode assembled fields are retained.
Standalone diagnostic position is clamped to input byte length and combined message/expected/found is bounded; mutation is atomic.
preserved_source_quirks: No whitespace skipping, biochemical residue lookup, formula/glycan resolution or cross-link partner validation.
Repeated chain names join with space/slash/space; ion name unused.
Mixed separators and contextual chain versus ion charge placement.
Integer decimal-prefix conversion and separate-sign double negatives.
Empty ambiguous sections (but not empty modified ranges), empty/trailing-comma global locations, separate unlocalised entries.
Actual unexpected-character diagnostics retained instead of illustrative header codes; expected/found remain empty during parsing.
Adduct writer aggregate-charge suffix is not consumed by parsing.
Numeric CV accession token spelling is retained without integral conversion.

limits.policy: Shared ledger across chains, lookahead scans and diagnostics. Cumulative requested buffer capacity is a logical conservative estimate, not exact allocator memory. Source limits did not exist.

licensing: Source-derived code retains OpenMS copyright/BSD-3-Clause notices; copied grammar fixtures retain original source origin comments. Historical writer provenance is preserved.
